identitySignals: The OUSD agenda text defines the counterparty as 'University of Massachusetts (University or UMG), a private, nonprofit affiliate of University of Massachusetts', i.e. UMass Global, not a Massachusetts campus
UMass Global (formerly Brandman University) is a California-based private nonprofit online university and part of the University of Massachusetts system (massachusetts.edu)
The agreement covers TK-12 teaching and pupil personnel services credential internships and fieldwork, matching a California university credential program serving California school districts
research.notes: The agenda names only 'University of Massachusetts' with no city; identified as UMass Global from the agenda's own definition ('UMG', a private nonprofit affiliate). No general email found on the homepage, so email is null.

profile.summary: UMass Global is a private, nonprofit online university based in California and part of the University of Massachusetts system. It offers bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees and certificates, mostly to working adults.

sources.title: University Of Massachusetts Global - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda text defines the counterparty as UMG, a private nonprofit affiliate of the University of Massachusetts, and the credential-program MOU with the Talent department fits UMass Global in California. The cited sources (umassglobal.edu, ProPublica, massachusetts.edu) support the name, EIN, address, phone, nonprofit status and a neutral summary.
